description: Classic trek starting from Nayapul through Ghorepani and Poon Hill. Passes through diverse landscapes from subtropical forests to alpine terrain. The final destination is the stunning Annapurna Sanctuary surrounded by a amphitheater of peaks.

A relatively short trek offering the best panoramic sunrise views in Nepal. The trail passes through beautiful rhododendron forests and traditional Magar and Gurung villages. Perfect for those with limited time who still want an authentic Himalayan experience.

The classic Everest Base Camp trek through the Khumbu region. The trail follows the Dudh Koshi River, crosses high suspension bridges, and passes through iconic Sherpa villages including Namche Bazaar. The trek culminates at Everest Base Camp with an optional hike to Kala Patthar for unparalleled views of Mount Everest.

A beautiful valley trek starting from Syabrubesi. The trail follows the Langtang River through lush forests, past waterfalls, and through traditional Tamang villages. The valley offers stunning views of Langtang Lirung and the opportunity to visit the sacred Kyanjin Gompa.
A pristine, uncrowded trail from Phedi through forest camps to the Mardi Himal ridgeline at 4,500m. Close-up views of Machhapuchhre and the full Annapurna range.
Remote circuit of Manaslu (8,163m) through the Budhi Gandaki valley and over the Larkya La. Tibetan-style villages, deep gorges, and alpine lakes.
Khumbu trek to the turquoise Gokyo lakes with an ascent of Gokyo Ri for a stunning Everest panorama.
Classic circuit crossing Thorong La (5,416m) through Manang and down the arid Mustang valley.
